title: AIMP Job Request (quote / execute)
description: Request envelope used for both aimp.quote and aimp.execute. For aimp.execute, either (a) provide a quote_id from a prior aimp.quote, or (b) repeat the full request with envelope.require_approval=false at operator risk (not recommended).

aimp_version.description: Semantic version of the AIMP spec the client is targeting.

idempotency_key.description: If the same key is seen twice, the gateway MUST return the original result.

device_id.description: Target device as returned by aimp.discover.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain namespace such as `manufacturing.additive.fdm.v1`.

quote_id.description: When present, this request MUST be treated as execution of the previously issued quote. All other parameters MUST match the quoted set.

asset.description: Optional digital asset the job operates on (STL, PNG, PDF, G-code, protocol file, ...).

format.description: MIME type or domain-defined format identifier.

payload.description: Domain-specific body, validated against the Domain Schema identified by `domain`.

logistics.description: Optional logistics block for domains that ship a physical artifact.

budget_limit.description: Upper bound the agent is allowed to spend on this job.

audit_requirements.description: Closed-loop observation policy for this job.

envelope.description: Request-level control flags and auth artifacts.

approval_token.description: Signed approval artifact when policy requires HITL sign-off (see §04.5).
